Check if current node is a leaf or internal node using the bit layout [S1, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly defines the bit layout for the Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) nodes. It states that bits 0-16 store a child pointer offset and bits 17-31 store a mask or type indicator. It further specifies that leaf nodes are indicated by the value `0x00004200` and internal nodes by `0x0000FFFF`. Therefore, one can determine if a node is a leaf or internal by checking these specific bit patterns/values within the defined layout.
